speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Nerve conduction study (right upper extremity): Abnormal findings consistent with radiculopathy or plexopathy; EMG (right upper extremity): Evidence of denervation in right C5-C6 myotomes with normal findings on the left side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor) causing C5-C6 radiculopathy.

The combination of a smoker's history, significant weight loss, right upper arm weakness/sensory loss, and EMG findings denervating C5-C6 strongly suggests a tumor in the lung apex compressing the brachial plexus.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor causing C5-C6 Radiculopathy.
